context: A police officer briefs a teen reporter on a court case
purpose: Teach: 弾圧/路上/戦場/破産/検察官/審理/通産省/外相

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 桜さん、今日の審理は重いネタですよ。覚悟して傍聴席に座ってくださいね。
lines.en: Sakura, today's hearing is heavy material. Brace yourself when you sit in the gallery.
lines.style: Veteran desk editor gently warning rookie before courtroom assignment

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、先輩。被告は元外相だと伺いましたが、本当ですか?
lines.en: Yes, senior. I heard the defendant is a former foreign minister—is that true?
lines.style: Eager teen reporter checking basic facts before heading out

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: そう。通産省から外務へ移って、最後は外相まで上り詰めた人物です。
lines.en: Right. He moved from MITI to foreign affairs and eventually became foreign minister.
lines.style: Calm editor sketching the defendant's career in plain terms

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 罪状は何になるんでしょう。検察官は何を一番強く問うつもりですか?
lines.en: What are the charges? What will the prosecutor press hardest on?
lines.style: Curious teen asking a focused practical question about strategy

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 言論弾圧への関与です。批判的な記事を書いた記者を路上で尾行させた疑いがある。
lines.en: Involvement in press suppression. He's suspected of having critical reporters tailed on the street.
lines.style: Editor stating allegations bluntly with seasoned matter-of-fact gravity

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ひどい……。それで職を失った記者もいるんですか?
lines.en: Awful... Were there reporters who lost their jobs because of it?
lines.style: Subdued teen voice expressing quiet shock and moral concern

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: ええ、廃刊に追い込まれた小誌もあって、編集長が破産した例まである。戦場帰りの記者ですらまいったそうですよ。
lines.en: Yes—small magazines were shut down, and one editor even went bankrupt. Even a war-zone veteran reporter was shaken.
lines.style: Somber senior editor recounting grim industry consequences from memory

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わかりました。冒頭陳述、しっかりメモを取ってきます!
lines.en: Understood. I'll take careful notes during the opening statement!
lines.style: Determined teen making earnest professional commitment with quiet resolve
